programme.title: THE ART OF... - EP1
programme.desc: Live. Peter and Kasper Schmeichel explore how the art of goalkeeping has evolved throughout the Premier League era. From the fundamentals of shot-stopping, positioning and commanding the penalty area to the modern demands of distribution and playing with the ball at your feet, the Schmeichels break down what it takes to be an elite goalkeeper. Featuring some of the Premier League's greatest number ones, the show examines how one of football's most specialised positions has been transformed.

PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli. Mancini's interview is brutally honest, highlighting the defining moments and extraordinary car.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP13
programme.desc: Live. programme.title: PL STORIES - EP24

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP4
